items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: a couple of years later Glenn Miller stole Billy from me... Glenn hired Billy instead of Bob

ctx.x: You were about to tell me an experience you had, on the end of the last reel.

Well, yes. First of all, I wanted to say that at all times, when you had a band and you were broadcasting or recording, there were always people bringing tunes to you and saying, 'Look, I'll put your name on it. You can publish it. You can put it in your company. If you'll just play it.' Now, this has not only happened to me, it's happened to everybody else that ever had a band. But I wanted to tell you about one particular event. We were having this rehearsal at the Blue Room, the Lincoln, at 2:00 o'clock in the…
